18 The respondent shall be entitled to appear before, and be heard by, the professional
panel either in person or by counsel or solicitor.

19 Subject to the provisions of this Part of this Schedule, a professional panel may
regulate its own procedure.
Application of provisions of Part I

20 Paragraphs 3, 7 and 8 of this Schedule shall apply in relation to a professional panel
as they apply in relation to a tribunal.

PART IV

APPLICATION OF PARTS I TO III TO NORTHERN IRELAND

specified in the first column of the following Table shall have effect subject to the
modifications specified in relation thereto in the second column of that Table.
